# Mallard — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the scientific name of the Mallard?", "Anas platyrhynchos"),
    ("What does the Mallard eat?", "plants, insects"),
    ("What is scientific name?", "Anas platyrhynchos"),
    ("What is size?", "58 cm"),

    ("What is diet?", "plants, insects"),
    ("What is range?", "Northern Hemisphere"),
    ("What is notable?", "Ancestor of most domestic ducks"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
